title: Zero-SNR Analyticity of the Scalar MMSE Is Equivalent to Gaussianity
abstract: arXiv:2609.15048v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Let $Y_s=\sqrt{s}X+Z$, where $Z$ is standard Gaussian and independent of the real random variable $X$. We prove that, under the square-exponential moment condition $\mathbb{E}e^{\beta X^2}<\infty$ for some $\beta>0$, the scalar minimum mean-square error $\operatorname{mmse}_X(s)$ is analytic at zero signal-to-noise ratio if and only if $X$ is Gaussian, with constant random variables included as degenerate Gaussians.   The proof converts estimation in the Gaussian channel into a backward heat flow acting on the moment-generating function $M(z)=\mathbb{E}e^{zX}$. Under the stated tail condition, every non-Gaussian input forces $M$ to have a nonzero complex zero. We show that each zero cluster produces a finite singularity in its localized Borel transform at the action $\xi=z_0^2/2$. translated_title: 标量最小均方误差在零信噪比处的解析性等价于高斯性
translated_abstract: 设 $Y_s=\sqrt{s}X+Z$，其中 $Z$ 是标准高斯随机变量，且与实随机变量 $X$ 独立。我们证明，在平方指数矩条件 $\mathbb{E}e^{\beta X^2}<\infty$（对某个 $\beta>0$）下，标量最小均方误差 $\operatorname{mmse}_X(s)$ 在零信噪比处解析，当且仅当 $X$ 服从高斯分布（常数随机变量被视为退化的高斯分布）。证明方法是将高斯信道中的估计问题转化为作用于矩生成函数 $M(z)=\mathbb{E}e^{zX}$ 的向后热流。在所述尾部条件下，任何非高斯输入都会迫使 $M$ 具有非零复零点。我们证明每个零点簇在其局域化 Borel 变换中的作用量 $\xi=z_0^2/2$ 处产生一个有限奇点。在去除作用量尺度之后，对于单零点情形，Borel 系数具有非零的 $n^{-1/2}$ 前置因子。重数为 $m\geq 2$ 的零点则会分裂……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文证明在平方指数矩条件下，标量最小均方误差在零信噪比处解析当且仅当输入服从高斯分布，其证明通过将高斯信道估计转化为矩生成函数上的向后热流，并分析 Borel 变换的奇点结构来完成。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that, under a square-exponential moment condition, the scalar MMSE is analytic at zero SNR if and only if the input is Gaussian, by converting estimation in the Gaussian channel into a backward heat flow on the moment-generating function and analyzing the finite singularities arising from its complex zeros in the localized Borel transform.
